title: SheepEatStonecutters
body:
"were not going to make it eat ... Stonecutters" - Phoenix SC, February 2025"
## 
This data pack make sheep eat Stonecutters. 
## 
I saw Phoenix SC's video where he shows off the ability to use the #edible_for_sheep tag to make sheep able to eat whatever you want them to eat and when he is testing he says that he isn't going to make sheep eat Stonecutters, I chuckled when I heard that and wanted to do exactly what he said he wouldn't do. So I did
